mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_follows (user_id, followed_user_id) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{followed_user_id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_follows WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND followed_user_id = #{followed_user_id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follows WHERE user_id = #{user_id} AND followed_user_id = #{followed_user_id}

SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.user_role, c.name AS circle_name FROM user_follows uf JOIN users u ON uf.followed_user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c2.name FROM user_circles uc JOIN circles c2 ON uc.circle_id = c2.circle_id WHERE uc.user_id = u.user_id LIMIT 1 ) c ON true WHERE uf.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC
